title: 第13章 魔力第14章 数学课与安德烈教授
slug: 穿越成了游戏里的炮灰角色
content_zh:
苏珊夫人的法阵在课室中熠熠生辉，仿佛古老的符文在现代的教室里重新获得了生命。
随着她手中的魔杖轻轻一挥，一个蓝色的光球从法阵的中心缓缓升起，它散发着柔和而神秘的光芒，如同夜空中最亮的星辰。
学生们感到一种前所未有的力量在体内涌动，仿佛有一股暖流在血管中奔腾，让人既兴奋又不安。
法伦默默感受着身体中的躁动，微微握紧拳头。
很快，苏珊夫人的声音如同春风化雨，安抚了学生们躁动的心。
“大家不要担心，这是小魔球，一种温和的召唤兽，是给召唤师供给魔力用的召唤兽。
我的这只小家伙在我的培养下，可以稍微提高一下一个小区域内的魔力浓度。”
苏珊夫人温和的声音安抚着有些不安的同学们，“你们现在感受到的体内的力量，就是你的魔力。”
法伦感受着体内那股躁动的力量，似乎在慢慢延伸到手掌处，法伦感到那股力量似乎在寻找出口，他缓缓张开手掌，一团透明的小火焰在他的掌心跳跃，如同精灵在指尖舞蹈。
法伦被吓了一跳，这一举动也立刻吸引了周围同学的目光，他们或是惊讶，或是好奇，或是嫉妒。
苏珊夫人眼神中闪过一丝赞许，微笑着看着法伦手中的小火苗，这正是学生们在学习召唤术时最需要掌握的第一步——感知并操控自身的魔力。
很好，法伦，你已经成功地将魔力具现为火焰。
苏珊夫人鼓励道，"
这不仅仅是一个简单的火焰，它代表着你与魔力的初次接触和交流。
记住，召唤术的精髓在于与召唤生物的沟通，而这种沟通，首先从感知和操控自己的魔力开始。
毕竟这是与灵界接触的最初媒介。
苏珊夫人的声音将班上所有学生的注意力都吸引了过来，即使是那位不可一世的凯撒少爷也不例外。
坐在最后一排的凯撒仅仅只是斜睨了法伦一眼，看到他手中那普通的透明火焰后，嘴角微微扬起一抹不屑的笑容，随即右手一张，一团漆黑如墨的火焰猛地从掌心升起，熊熊燃烧，仿佛来自地狱深渊的黑炎，散发着令人心悸的气息。
坐在周围的同学都被凯撒的黑炎吓了一跳，纷纷挪动着位置。
索菲娅与艾丽莎也是饶有兴致地多看了法伦几眼，但她们并未如凯撒那般炫技般地释放出自己的魔力。

特别是艾丽莎，只见她自言自语地说：“法伦是吗......”
千代则是面带微笑，友善地向法伦点了点头，表示赞许和鼓励。
其他学生们见状，纷纷兴奋起来，开始尝试着模仿法伦的动作，张开手掌，试图召唤出属于自己的火焰。
然而，并不是每个人都能像法伦那样轻松做到。
有的学生手掌中只是冒出了一丝微弱的光芒，仿佛风中残烛随时可能熄灭；有的则是完全没有任何反应，一脸茫然地看着自己的手掌，不知所措。
苏珊夫人耐心地指导着每一位学生，"
不要急，召唤术需要时间和耐心。
每个人的魔力都是独特的，找到适合自己的方式才是最重要的。
随着时间的推移，越来越多的学生开始成功地召唤出了自己的火焰。
虽然它们大小不一，大多数颜色都是透明的，但也有像凯撒那种带有鲜明个人色彩的火焰，这样的同学自然更引人注目。
法伦凝视着手中跳跃的火焰，心中涌起一股莫名的兴奋感。
他能清晰地感觉到，这股神秘而强大的力量正逐渐与自己融为一体。
他小心翼翼地尝试着控制火焰的出现，尽管动作略显生疏，但已经能明显察觉到火焰对自己的回应。
这魔力火焰的形状能不能改变呢?"
法伦心中突然冒出这样一个疑问。
content_en:
Mrs. Susan's magic circle shines in the classroom, as if ancient runes have taken on new life in the modern classroom.
With a slight wave of the wand in her hand, a blue ball of light slowly rose from the center of the circle. It exuded a soft and mysterious light, like the brightest star in the night sky.
The students felt an unprecedented power surge in their bodies, as if there was a warm current rushing through their blood vessels, which made people both excited and uneasy.
Fallon silently felt the restlessness in his body and clenched his fists slightly.
Soon, Mrs. Susan's voice was like spring breeze, calming the restless hearts of the students.
"Don't worry, everyone, this is a small magic ball, a gentle summoned beast that provides magic power to the summoner.
With my training, this little guy of mine can slightly increase the concentration of magic power in a small area. "
Mrs. Susan's gentle voice comforted the somewhat uneasy classmates, "The power you feel in your body now is your magic power."
Fallon felt the restless power in his body, which seemed to be slowly extending to his palms. Fallon felt that the power seemed to be looking for an outlet. He slowly opened his palms, and a small transparent flame danced in his palms, like an elf dancing on his fingertips.
Fallon was startled, and this move immediately attracted the attention of the surrounding students. They were either surprised, curious, or jealous.
A hint of approval flashed in Mrs. Susan's eyes, and she looked at the small flame in Fallon's hand with a smile. This is the first step that students need to master when learning summoning - to perceive and control their own magic.
Well done, Fallon, you've succeeded in manifesting your magic into fire.
Mrs. Susan encouraged, "
This is more than just a simple flame, it represents your first contact and communication with magic.
Remember, the essence of summoning lies in communication with summoned creatures, and this communication starts with sensing and controlling one's own magic power.
After all this is the original medium of contact with the spirit world.
Mrs. Susan's voice attracted the attention of all the students in the class, even the arrogant Master Caesar.
Caesar, who was sitting in the last row, just glanced sideways at Fallon. After seeing the ordinary transparent flame in his hand, he raised a slight smile of disdain. Then he opened his right hand, and a black flame suddenly rose from the palm of his hand, burning like a black flame from the abyss of hell, exuding a heart-stopping aura.
The students sitting around were all startled by Caesar's black flames, and they all moved their positions.
Sophia and Alyssa also looked at Fallon with interest, but they did not release their magic like Caesar.
Especially Alyssa, I saw her saying to herself: "Is Fallon..."
Chiyo smiled and nodded to Fallon in a friendly manner, expressing approval and encouragement.
When the other students saw this, they became excited and began to try to imitate Fallon's movements, opening their palms and trying to summon their own flames.
However, not everyone can do it as easily as Fallon.
Some students only had a faint gleam of light in their palms, as if a candle in the wind might be extinguished at any time; some showed no reaction at all, looking at their palms blankly and at a loss.
Mrs. Susan patiently guides every student,"
Don't rush, summoning requires time and patience.
Everyone's magic is unique, and finding the way that suits you is the most important thing.
As time passed, more and more students began to successfully summon their own flames.
Although they vary in size and most of the colors are transparent, there are also flames with distinctive personal colors like Caesar's, which are naturally more eye-catching.
Fallon stared at the jumping flames in his hands, and a feeling surged in his heart.Inexplicable excitement.
He could clearly feel that this mysterious and powerful force was gradually integrating with himself.
He carefully tried to control the appearance of the flame. Although his movements were a little unfamiliar, he could already clearly feel the flame's response to him.
Can the shape of this magical flame be changed?"
A question suddenly popped up in Fallon's mind.
